title: CMS Showcase Product Slider
description:
This CMS block is used to attract the attention of users by the combination of CTA banners and product sliders and to guide them specifically to categories or brands.

---

summary: A promotional CMS block combining a CTA banner with a product slider to guide shoppers toward categories or brands.
features: Side-by-side layout pairing CTA Banner Basic with Product Slider
Responsive design: 30% banner width on desktop, full-width stacked on mobile
Customizable background colors (light or dark mode)
Edge-bleeding slider items for visual interest beyond container bounds
longDescription:
## Purpose

The CMS Showcase Product Slider combines promotional messaging with product discovery in a single attention-grabbing block. It enables merchants to pair compelling CTA banners with curated product selections, driving shoppers toward specific categories or brand collections.

## Use Cases

- **Brand storytelling**: Feature a brand banner alongside its product range
- **Category promotion**: Highlight a category with lifestyle imagery and product previews
- **Seasonal campaigns**: Combine promotional messaging with relevant product selections
- **New collection launches**: Introduce collections with descriptive banners and product samples

## Design Rationale

The component leverages the visual impact of full-bleed imagery combined with scannable product previews. The 30/70 desktop split prioritizes product discovery while maintaining strong promotional presence. Mobile-first stacking ensures the banner context appears before products. Edge-bleeding slider items create visual momentum and encourage horizontal exploration.
